description: This file defines the PHP class Opencart\System\Library\Cache\Mem, which implements a caching mechanism using Memcache for OpenCart's system library. It includes methods for setting, getting, and deleting cache entries, along with class properties and constants related to cache expiration and dumping limit.

classes.name: Mem
classes.description: A class for managing cache storage using Memcache within the OpenCart system library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache connection with optional expiration time parameter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with a specified key and expiration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cached value by key.
